verdict.rationale: Lambda documents filesystems as high-capacity regional file stores you attach to instances to store datasets and back up system state. An S3-compatible adapter (rclone/s5cmd) supports moving data in and out, and MK8s adds shared persistent storage across 1CC nodes. Together these deliver persistent network storage separate from any single GPU rental. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that filesystem data survives instance termination, any mention of checkpoint workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of persistence.
